question: Which Indian female shooter had won the gold medal in individual 10 m air rifle women event at the 2019 ISSF World Cup in New Delhi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Apurvi Chandela.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Apurvi Chandela** became the world number one in women’s 10m Air Rifle category in the 2019 ISSF World Cup.
 
• She is an Indian athlete who competes in the event of 10-metre air rifle sport shooting.
 
• She belongs to Rajasthan state.
 
• She was awarded the Arjuna awards 2016.
 
• Her Achievements:
 
 
• **2019 ISSF World Cup - Gold**
 
• 2014 Commonwealth Games - Gold
 
• 2015 World Cup Final - Silver
 
• She will be representing India again at the 2021 Tokyo Olympics.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Shooting:

 
 
• It is an important Olympic sport in India.
 
• Some of the most prominent Indian shooters include Abhinav Bindra, Jitu Rai, Rajyavardhan Singh Rathore, Vijay Kumar, Apurvi Chandela, Anjali Bhagwat, and many others.
 
• Chandro Tomar and Prakashi Tomar are the oldest and second oldest most acclaimed international female veteran shooters from India.
